purpose: Post-hoc exploratory explanation of existing predictions; no new training or fitting
budget_rule: Integer floor using exact rational fractions; full curves include every k from 0 through N
ties: Risk descending, original run identifier ascending; bootstrap duplicate identifiers append underscore and zero-based draw position as in original analysis
failure: Frozen original WGA < 0.75; exactly 0.75 is non-failure

bootstrap.invalid_rule: Exclude empty or single-outcome pools for interval comparability with original bootstrap; report counts. Raw audit counts remain defined for single-outcome pools.
bootstrap.interval: 2.5/97.5 percentile pointwise; conditional on frozen predictors; no selection uncertainty or simultaneous-curve coverage

reference: Saved fitted StandardScaler mean in imputed input space. Replace raw finite slope with that value; verify transformed component zero. No evaluation mean, no refitting, no causal interpretation.

interpretation.temporal_hint: L8 advantage over both E and L6, with panel/family diagnostics reported; no post-hoc success declaration
interpretation.narrower_hint: L6 advantage over E without added L8 discovery supports investigation of order-free layer summaries, subject to independent validation and novelty assessment
interpretation.no_gain: No additional discovery across budgets supports revising or stopping this representation; do not silently enlarge the study
interpretation.decision: Continue independent validation, revise narrower contribution, or stop current representation; no automatic further training

limitations: Outcomes already unsealed: this freeze is not a preregistered untouched evaluation
Overlapping budgets and panels are not independent tests
Only ten held-out setting families sharing MNIST and outcome panels
Earlier temporal reliability and structural interpretation unresolved
Original nonlinear capacity and prediction-depth comparator limitations unchanged
